inputs.objective: Independently validate the frozen U.S. Treasury primary-dealer auction constraint mechanism and determine whether it is eligible for a bounded predeclared economic test without inspecting outcomes.

allowed_actions: read frozen hypothesis and Legacy state
verify New York Fed primary-dealer operating policy and historical dealer list
verify Treasury auction announcement/history/query availability and auction clock
assess PIT reconstructability and define claim restriction
forbidden_actions: tune an expression on realized outcomes
success_condition: Return PASS_TO_TEST_DESIGN, PARK_DATA or KILL_MECHANISM with exact reasons and no outcome access.
